name: 災害対策本部に事務局を設置
summary: 災害対策本部条例に、事務局を設けることなどを加えます。事務局長の役割と事務局職員の仕事の進め方も定め、公布の日から施行します。
changes: 本部長室に事務局を置く
事務局長を置き、本部長の補佐や本部の運営に必要な総合調整を担わせる
事務局職員は事務局長の指示を受けて事務を行う
why: 事務局や事務局長、事務局に属する職員について定めるためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Establishes a secretariat in the disaster response headquarters
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Chofu City Disaster Countermeasures Headquarters Ordinance
en.summary: Adds provisions to the Disaster Countermeasures Headquarters Ordinance to establish a secretariat. It also sets out the role of the secretariat director and how secretariat staff carry out their work. The ordinance takes effect on the date of promulgation.
changes: Places a secretariat in the headquarters chief's office
Appoints a secretariat director to assist the headquarters chief and coordinate matters needed to run the headquarters
Requires secretariat staff to carry out their duties under the secretariat director's instructions
en.why: The city says this is to set out provisions concerning the secretariat, its director and the staff who belong to it.
